chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whatever you whisper to your Lord in salat (prayer) is not considered speech.

key_terms.الصَّلاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act of worship
key_terms.رَبَّكَ: your Lord, the One being addressed in worship
key_terms.ناجَيْتَ: you whispered privately or confided intimately

ai.seo_question: Does speaking privately to Allah in salat (prayer) count as ordinary speech?
ai.summary: This hadith states that intimate supplication and whispered discourse with Allah during salat (prayer) is not treated as ordinary human speech. It indicates the permissibility of addressing one's Lord in prayer without invalidating the act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1416 - Imam (as) said:
"Whatever you whisper to your Lord (azj) in prayer is not considered speech”.
